nāgasutta: [Nāga+sutta]  CL=1 Naga Sutta: (a) In the case of all the elephants clinging to the lake in the wilderness of Taw Myaing, almost all the elephants descend into the lake, remove the ivory stalks with their noses, wash them thoroughly, and wash them thoroughly. In the same way, in this Dhamma and Discipline, the monks who have entered the village and the end of the Dhamma, just as they do not attain to mortal misery, enjoy the bribes of the people because of their preaching, and they use bribes without lust. As a result of this consumption, one attains both beauty and power. Or how he did not suffer to the point of death; When they descend into the pool and do not move the ivory root well, the young elephants that swallow it and swallow it do not get the two effects of beauty. The Dhamma is preached to those who come to the village or the end of the world as if they were suffering to the point of death, and the young monks who cling to the four things donated by the people"s faith, such as alms robes, die without gaining the double benefit. (B) The elephants, fully developed in dependence on the king of the Himalayas, descend into the great lake, the great river, the great river, the great river, the great river, the great river, the great river, the great river, the great river. (C) Listening to the elephant, being able to kill and defeat the enemy on one side, being able to withstand the onslaught of the enemy on the other side, being able to go quickly to the place where the elephant keeper wants to go, hearing the Buddha"s teachings Enduring the torment of swearing, affliction, sometimes in an unpredictable cycle The fourfold path leading to Nibbဗ္ဗာန်na, which has never been reached, is to be worshiped by human beings and devas. - The dangers of associating with evil people (asappurisa)
